rationale: Read complete actual-batcher loopback test and current batcher/identity lifecycle context. Bounded 8MiB producer respects real pause callback; distinct visible bulk/small-write and hidden scenarios have explicit pause/input/drain oracles. Clears batcher and destroys/closes all sockets in finally. Current run passes. Socket queues directly measure retention; RSS and received framing bytes are observations.

cases.title: visible 64KiB producer pauses for stalled real socket reader and drains
cases.reason: Actual batcher/socket backlog triggers producer pause before 8MiB loop limit; resume must drain socket/batcher queues within five seconds.

cases.title: visible 1KiB producer pauses for stalled real socket reader and drains
cases.reason: Distinct small-write path drives actual socket bytes rather than only held bulk; requires pause and eventual queue drain.

cases.title: hidden 1KiB producer processes all 8MiB without pause and drains
cases.reason: Actual keep-tail droppable path must accept full bounded workload without producer pause, then drain. Held size/RSS are recorded, not asserted against a hardcoded cap.
